evidence: Matches the 'Wallet' label and directly modifies wallet coin selection logic in `SelectionResult::Clear()`.
rationale: Fixes an invariant bug in `SelectionResult::Clear()` where clearing selected inputs preserved the bump fee discount, resulting in negative bump fees. As noted in the description, 'the wallet currently avoids this because it only clears selections inside the knapsack solver, before applying the discount,' making this a latent correctness issue rather than an active user-facing failure.
